scoring_justification: Full recompute from raw artifacts is infeasible because the analytical model requires double numerical integrations over the electron and phonon distributions; the verifier compares the agent's reported values against digitized gold values from the paper's figures with tolerances. This tier ensures independent verification of the headline results without re‑implementing the complex model.

hidden_assets.purpose: Digitized reference values for power dissipation and velocity–field curves
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Digitized from Fig. 1 and Fig. 2 of the source paper, Ridley et al., J. Appl. Phys. 96, 1499 (2004)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manual reading of the published graphs; values rounded to three significant digits.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The values are taken directly from the published figures and are not invented. They represent the paper's own reported results.

outputs.description: Power dissipation per electron vs electron temperature. The checker will compare the values at selected probe temperatures against digitized reference data from a published figure, applying appropriate tolerances.

Drift velocity vs electric field for five electron densities. The checker will compare drift velocity at selected fields against digitized reference velocity-field curves, applying appropriate tolerances, and verify monotonic saturation trends.

output_contract.notes: The model uses an analytical hot-phonon framework with nonparabolic band and LO phonon kinetics. All material constants are taken from the public literature; no external datasets are required.
